cases.name: lrgb_mono_ngc7635
cases.golden_note: Frozen floor re-cut 2026-09-07 for v5.0.3.1. ONE attributed cause, measured on this corpus. The shadow point is now bounded so it can send at most 0.5% of a frame to black: SP = min(median - 2.8 sigma, the 0.5th percentile). On this corpus's own stacked output, single variable, same auto_tune: SP 0.14356 -> 0.14309 (median - 2.8 sigma -> median - 3.12 sigma), pixels clipped to black 1.055% -> 0.495%, largest clipped clump 16 px -> 10 px, stretched spread (p99.9 - p50) 0.4710 -> 0.4655 (a 1.2% cost) with the background unmoved at 0.2500. That moves `stretched` and NOTHING else. Verified before the re-cut, against the v5.0.3.0 golden: stacked c7265ace, noise 74316401, composed abb09e5c and all three sweep entries (GHS 0fb26715, MTF 8a05ae80, ArcSinh 83a512e7) came back BIT-IDENTICAL. That is also the single-variable proof that v5.0.3.1's meridian-flip fix is a no-op where there is no flip: this corpus reports 0 meridian-flipped frames and its whole stacking pipeline is unchanged. The sweeps are unmoved because GHS/MTF/ArcSinh do not use VeraLux's auto_tune. Do not re-cut this floor without the same kind of measurement.

cases.name: mono_lrgb_m27_2025
cases.alignment_note: 51 of 72 measured 2026-09-04. The 21 failures are the two temporal ends of a 7-hour session: chronological frames 0-19 and 66-71. Failure rate rises monotonically with distance from the reference (0-15 frames away: 31 ok / 0 failed; 32-39 away: 0 ok / 9 failed), and the reference is already the temporal midpoint, so this is cumulative tracking drift the single-reference matcher cannot bridge -- not filter, and not reference selection, which took this case from 1 of 72 to 51 of 72. Raise this floor when chained alignment lands.
cases.note: Re-enabled 2026-09-05. Phase B now carries a per-channel frame set: CacheSig gained a routing key so each mono filter gets its own cache, ShadowBuffers::n_frames is per channel, and global_frame_of maps each channel's local slot to the batch-global frame its FrameStats belong to. The golden for this case has never existed -- the previous one was deleted because it recorded three empty channels -- so it is generated fresh in this re-baseline.
